issues.problem: nisakidatte mistake 2 (社長の挨拶にさきだって、乾杯をしました) is grammatical and natural; it is only wrong if one assumes the toast came after, so the 'bad' sentence was not actually wrong.
issues.action: Replaced with a genuinely unnatural use: 雨にさきだって、洗濯物を取り込んだ → 雨が降るまえに、洗濯物を取り込んだ (a natural occurrence is not a planned event).
